verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe self-hosted CodeRabbit, which runs the review agent (the core product) inside your own infrastructure instead of CodeRabbit's cloud. The FAQ confirms self-hosting is available on Enterprise and lets you opt out of all data retention. Missing for 10: detailed setup and deployment requirements, clarity on which features beyond the review agent work self-hosted, availability below the Enterprise tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
